0022600139.text: The Timberwolves (3-1, 3rd in the Northwest and 6th in the West) host the Golden State Warriors (1-3, 4th in the Pacific and 12th in the West) in their fifth game of the 2026-27 season, with Minnesota on a one-game losing streak after winning three of four and Golden State riding a one-game winning streak. Minnesota is missing Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), while Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Minnesota won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 127-117 win in San Francisco on March 13, 2026.
